chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal and Al-Hajjal, from Thal'abah, from Abu Khalid Al-Qammam, from Abdul-Khaliq Al-Sayqal, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And whoever enters it shall be secure.'
So he (peace be upon him) said: 'You have asked me about something which no one would ask me except for the one whom Allah so Desires to.'

He said: 'The one who travels to this House (the Kaaba) and he knows that it is the House which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has Commanded with, and recognises us, the People of the Household, as it is our right to be recognised, would be safe in the world and the Hereafter.'

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the Household (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.حَقَّ مَعْرِفَتِنَا: Right of our recognition (Wilayah/authority of the Imams)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for true security in the Kaaba according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates the concept of *aman* (security) from mere physical protection within the Kaaba to a comprehensive spiritual safeguarding in both the worldly life and the Hereafter. He establishes that true security is contingent upon *ma'rifah* (gnosis) of the Ahl al-Bayt, linking the physical sanctuary of the House of Allah with the spiritual sanctuary of the Prophet's family. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the inseparable connection between correct theological recognition and ultimate divine safety.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, and Al hajjal, from Sa’albat, from Abu Khalid Al Qammat, from Abdul Khaliq Al Sayqal who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [3:97] and whoever enters it shall be secure.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You have asked me about something which no one would (ask) me<sup>asws</sup> except for the one whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to.

The one who travels to this House (Kabah) and he knows that it is the House (Kabah) which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Commanded with, and recognises us<sup>asws</sup>, the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household as it is our<sup>asws</sup> right to be recognised, would be safe in the world and the Hereafter’.
en.sarwar: 25. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal and al-Hajjal from Tha’labah from abu Khalid al- Qammat from ‘Abd al-Khaliq al-Sayqal who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, ‘One who enters it is safe.’ [3:97]
He (the Imam) said, ‘You have asked me about something about which no one has asked except those whom Allah wanted to ask.

Whoever decides to visit this House and knows that this is the House, Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has commanded to visit and knows and acknowledges the rights of Ahl al-Bayt properly, he is safe in this life and in the next life.’”
